description: Per-topic throughput, partition skew, retained data and storage growth with a linear forecast. Topic and partition sizes come from KMinion (Kafka admin API), throughput per topic from the brokers' JMX.

panels.description: Topics matching the topic filter (internal topics starting with __ are hidden by KMinion).
panels.title: Topics

panels.description: Partitions of the selected topics. Each partition is a directory with segment files on every replica; partitions cost memory, file handles and controller work.
panels.title: Partitions

panels.description: Bytes of the selected topics on all brokers' log directories, replicas included (KMinion DescribeLogDirs).
panels.title: Data on disk

panels.description: Records appended per second to the selected topics (rate of the partitions' high watermarks, i.e. committed records).
panels.title: Messages in

panels.description: How much the selected topics grow per day at the current rate (linear trend over the last 6 hours). Negative = retention deletes more than producers write.
panels.title: Growth per day

panels.description: Total size of all log directories per broker (KMinion). Compare with the volume size on Kafka Pods & Nodes.
panels.title: Broker disk (all log dirs)

panels.description: Configuration and size of every selected topic (KMinion topic info). Sort by any column; click a topic name to filter the dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (topic_name, partition_count, replication_factor, min_insync_replicas, cleanup_policy, retention_ms, retention_bytes) (kminion_kafka_topic_info{kafka_cluster="$kafka_cluster",topic_name=~"$topic"})

panels.title: Topic inventory

panels.description: Committed records per second per topic, derived from the high watermark (works for every client and includes transactional markers). Click a series to filter the dashboard on that topic.
panels.title: Messages in per topic

panels.description: Produced (up) and consumed (down) bytes per topic from the brokers' BrokerTopicMetrics. Topics without traffic are not listed (Kafka creates the per-topic metrics lazily).
panels.title: Bytes in / out per topic

panels.description: Produce and fetch requests per second per topic. Many requests with few messages each (compare with Messages in) mean small batches: raise linger.ms / batch.size on producers.
panels.title: Produce / fetch requests per topic

panels.description: Messages per produce request per topic. Values near 1 mean producers send every record on its own — expensive for brokers. 10+ is healthy for busy topics.
panels.title: Average batch size (messages per produce request)

panels.description: Each row is one partition of the selected topics, the colour its produce rate. A single bright row = a hot partition (skewed message keys); consumers of that partition will lag first. Select one topic for a readable picture.
panels.title: Partition skew: messages in per partition

panels.description: High watermark minus low watermark: records currently retained per partition. Big differences between partitions of one topic mean skew; a partition that never shrinks may have retention misconfigured.
panels.title: Retained messages per partition (top 20)

panels.description: Bytes on disk per topic summed over all replicas, stacked. Sawtooth patterns are retention deleting whole segments (segment.bytes / segment.ms).
panels.title: Size per topic (all replicas)

panels.description: Linear forecast (predict_linear over the last 6 h) of the selected topics' total size. A forecast far above 'now' means retention is not keeping up; compare the 7-day value with the disk size of your brokers.
panels.title: Size forecast: now vs. in 24 h and 7 days

panels.description: Total bytes in each broker's log directories (all topics, all replicas). Imbalance between brokers means unbalanced partition placement.
panels.title: Log dir size per broker

panels.description: Topics ranked by growth rate (deriv over 6 h × 1 day). Topics on top will fill disks first.
panels.title: Fastest growing topics (per day)
